title: Machines on Machines looks the same on the base theme
description:
The extraction touches a live site. It must not change what readers see.

```gherkin
Feature: Machines on Machines on the base theme

  Scenario: Pages match before and after
    Given Machines on Machines built on the base theme plus its own brand pack
    When its home, section and article pages are compared with the current site at phone, laptop and wide widths
    Then they match
    And its site hooks no longer build cards or layout
```
